summary: A cyberpunk flying taxi cab: a 4.8 m lofted yellow four-door body (a city-cab footprint) with a black checker… joints fan_f_l, fan_r_l, fan_f_r, fan_r_r; sockets seat_driver, seat_passenger.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.flying_taxi_cyber or place "prefab": "flying_taxi_cyber" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
